# Oriental Sports Pune

> Sports goods store and turnkey sports court builder at Shop 247, MG Road, New Modikhana, Camp, Pune 411001, India. Sells cricket, badminton, tennis, football, pickleball, table tennis, squash, fitness, gym, recreation and volleyball equipment, strings racquets and knocks in cricket bats in-house, and builds turnkey courts (surface, fencing, lighting, line marking) for clubs, schools, societies and homes across Pune and Maharashtra.
